        # Look for: router.get\(..., {

        # }
        # Should be: }\);
        content = re.sub\(
            r'\(preserveScroll:\\s*true,\)\\n\(\\s*\)\\}\(\\s*\)\\n\(\\s*\)\\}',
            r'\\1\\n\\2}\);\\n\\4}',
            content
        \)
        
        # Fix pattern 2: const labels with wrong closing
        # Look for: const labels = {
        #   ...
        # }\);
        # Should be: };
        content = re.sub\(
            r'\(exclu:\\s*[\\'"]Exclu[\\'"],\)\\n\(\\s*\)\\}\\\);',
            r'\\1\\n\\2};',
            content
        \)
        
        # Fix pattern 3: router.put with missing closing parenthesis
        content = re.sub\(
            r'\(onError:\\s*\\\(\\\)\\s*=>\\s*hideLoader\\\(\\\),\)\\n\(\\s*\)\\}\(\\s*\)\\n\(\\s*\)\\}',
            r'\\1\\n\\2}\);\\n\\4}',
            content
        \)
        
        if content != original:
            with open\(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
                f.write\(content\)
            print\(f"Fixed: {filepath}"\)

print\("Done!"\)
